title: Least Recently Used Cache
prompt:
Implement a struct `LruCache` with a fixed positive capacity that supports:

  LruCache::new(capacity: usize)                    create an empty cache
  get(&mut self, key: i32) -> Option<i32>           the value stored for key, or None if absent. A successful get counts as a use.
  put(&mut self, key: i32, value: i32)              store value under key (overwriting any existing value; this counts as a use). If inserting a new key would exceed capacity, first evict the key that was used least recently.

Both operations should run in O(1) average time. std only (a HashMap plus a doubly linked list stored in a Vec with index links works well in safe Rust).

Example:
  let mut c = LruCache::new(2);
  c.put(1, 10); c.put(2, 20);
  c.get(1)      -> Some(10)
  c.put(3, 30); // evicts key 2
  c.get(2)      -> None
